title: Installation diagnostics
scope: Local file selected by you. Informational snapshot only; it does not confirm the current installation or send data.
lostKey: If the key is lost, secrets cannot be recovered and the provider cannot help.
invalid: Invalid diagnostic file. No content was stored.
unknown: Unknown status: generate and open diagnostics from your installation.
staleReport: Old diagnostic report: generate another before trusting the status.
oldBackup: Backup missing or older than the configured interval.
noKeyCopy: No exported and checked key copy.
vaultUnavailable: Vault unavailable: check the installation key.
tlsInvalid: Invalid TLS: external exposure must be refused.
healthy: No alerts in this snapshot; test restoration regularly.
proxy_declared: TLS proxy declared; external configuration unverified
refresh: Run titan-diagnostics on your installation; open only its diagnostic JSON, never keys, .env or databases.
